title: refresh_styles drops a vanished translate_style but neither re-asks nor invalidates the card
trigger: On the Translate tab pick a custom style and get a result (or leave it loading); the server then removes that style (updateTextCompositionStyles from another device).
effect: translate_style becomes None so the title reads 'To <language>' while the shown/arriving result was made with the removed style, and Apply applies it.
fix: Route the Translate branch through request_in(Translate) like the Style branch so the stale card is replaced.

title: A group bot user whose getUser send failed is never asked again
trigger: Open a group whose bot_commands name unknown bots while the sender is failing.
effect: asked_bot_users.insert(user_id) happens before the send; on send error the id stays in the set, so later ticks skip it and the bot's commands never show in the / menu for the session.
fix: Insert into asked only after a successful send, or keep a Fetch<()> per user.

title: Chat media counts: entry is inserted before six requests; a failed filter leaves a zero count forever
trigger: Open the info panel; one getChatMessageCount fails
effect: chat_media_counts[chat] is inserted as default and never re-asked ('once per chat per session'); the failing filter shows 0
fix: Per-filter Fetch<i32> that retries on reopen.

title: request_close restores shutdown on send failure but not the logout_request that begin_close cleared
trigger: A logOut is in flight (logout_request Some), then request_close is called and its send fails.
effect: shutdown goes back but auth_state.logout_request stays None, so TDLib's logOut answer is no longer matched.
fix: Make begin_close return an undo token or save/restore both fields together (one ShutdownPhase carrying the logout request).

title: maybe_send_parameters leaves the SetParameters pending entry when send_json fails
trigger: setTdlibParameters send fails (sender closed) on kickoff or an ingest; every later ingest registers another SetParameters request.
effect: Pending registry accumulates dead SetParameters entries until swept; parameters_sent bool shadows the WaitTdlibParameters stage.
fix: take(extra) on send failure like the other senders; derive 'sent' from the auth stage instead of a bool.

title: resume_disk_paused_found takes the whole due list, then returns on the first toggle error
trigger: Several found paused downloads are due and the first toggle_download_paused send fails.
effect: The remaining ids were already mem::taken and are never resumed; save_disk_pauses_if_changed is skipped.
fix: Keep ids queued until each is sent, and always run the save step.

title: pump_call_audio errors are mapped to 'changed' every poll
trigger: A group call is active and send_speaking keeps failing (sender closed).
effect: request_tick returns true every poll, forcing a redraw loop.
fix: Treat a send error as unchanged and surface it once.

title: A flood-retry re-send that fails drops an export request via settle_lost_request, which never clears the export link's pending
trigger: During an export a getChatHistory gets a 429 (retained and retried), and the re-send's send_json fails (TDLib closing / connection teardown).
effect: settle_lost_request feeds a generic error to the reducer, not to WorkerLink::reply, so link.pending stays Some(id): idle_or_cancelled() is false and no further export request is forwarded; the worker waits out QUERY_TIMEOUT per call.
fix: Route ExportAccount/ExportChat/ExportRichHtml lost requests to link.fail_send (or reply with an error) in settle_lost_request.

title: GIF search asks the inline bot with the main window's open chat, not the chat of the panel's window
trigger: Open the GIF panel in a chat window while the main window shows another chat (or none).
effect: getInlineQueryResults carries the wrong chat id (0 when none).
fix: Pass the asking window's chat into search_gifs.

title: grams_tick records asked_users/asked_chats even when the lookup send failed
trigger: Open My Grams while a peer lookup send fails.
effect: That peer is never asked again, its row keeps the bare id.
fix: Insert into the asked set only when the send succeeded.

title: Collect password box goes idle with no message when the request fails to send
trigger: Open Collect, type the password, submit while the send fails (not connected).
effect: withdraw is replaced by Password{request: None, error: None}; the Err is returned but the box shows no error, so Submit looks like it did nothing.
fix: Put the send error into GramWithdraw::idle(Some(error)) on the Err arm.

title: set_requested is inserted before mask_request, so a send error marks the set as requested for good
trigger: Open the photo editor Masks strip while sender fails once
effect: That set's stickers are never fetched again until the installed list changes (set_requested.clear in state masks.rs:118); strip shows blank set
fix: Insert into set_requested only after send_json succeeds, or remove it in mask_request's Err arm

title: send_sharing_request closes the request box (enable=None) before toggleChatHasProtectedContent is sent
trigger: Press Send Request while the sender refuses.
effect: The box is already gone and the request is not sent; only the returned Err tells the caller.
fix: Clear enable only after the send succeeds.

title: answer_sharing_request reads only histories, so a request shown in a topic or other view cannot be answered
trigger: Accept a sharing request shown in a view other than the chat's main history.
effect: answerable is false and the press does nothing.
fix: Use loaded_message.

title: set_profile_accent_color sends background emoji id 0 when the own user is not loaded
trigger: Pick a profile color before the own user record is in the cache.
effect: unwrap_or(0) clears the user's profile icon instead of keeping it.
fix: Refuse the call (InvalidRequest) when the own user is unknown.

title: edit_proxy and remove_proxy drop the ping result before the mutation is accepted
trigger: Press Remove or Edit on a proxy while another mutation is in flight.
effect: pings.remove(&proxy_id) runs, then send_proxy_mutation returns InvalidRequest because mutating is true; the ping result of the untouched proxy is lost.
fix: Clear the ping inside the accepted branch.

title: LiveSender notes the retry stash after td_send, so a fast 429 answer can be handled before the request is stashed
trigger: A retryable read is rate limited and answered on the receive thread before send_json returns.
effect: take_retained finds nothing, the retry is skipped, and the later note leaves a stash entry nobody removes (cleared only when 256 fill up).
fix: Insert into the stash before td_send and remove it when the send fails.

title: zoom_stat_graph records the zoom before load_stat_graph can refuse, and zoomed is keyed by token only
trigger: Zoom a graph while the chats path is inactive.
effect: zoomed[token]=x is set but nothing loads; the view shows a zoomed graph with no data.
fix: Record the zoom only when the load is issued and key it by (chat, token).

title: fetch_message_statistics sets statistics = Loading before the send and returns the send error with Loading left
trigger: Open a post's statistics while the send fails (AgentDriving or Native).
effect: The page spins forever; only Failed gets the Retry path, and a Loading page is not retried.
fix: Set Loading only after the send succeeds, or return to Idle on the send error.

title: Wallet one-shot request flags are set before the send and some are never cleared on failure
trigger: Open the Money page while the send fails (state_requested/rates_requested stay true), or while getApplicationConfig is refused by TDLib.
effect: state_requested and rates_requested stay true after a failed send, and explorer_url_requested has no error arm at all, so the Gram USD rate and explorer address are never asked again this session and the fiat value shows a dash.
fix: Fetch<T> per resource (rates, explorer config, own state) with Failed re-askable on the next Money page open.

title: Ninth queued external link is dropped silently and reported as accepted
trigger: While the UI is busy or locked, open nine different tg:// links from the OS.
effect: push_external_link returns true and raises the window, but links past MAX_QUEUED are not queued; the user gets no word that the link was ignored.
fix: Return a result enum {Queued, Duplicate, Full} and tell the user when the inbox is full.

title: ensure_private_dir remembers a directory as created once per process; nothing notices the directory being removed
trigger: Quill runs for days; the OS temp cleaner removes quill-media-cache/<account>/gif-frames; render paths call ensure_private_dir every frame.
effect: The dir is never recreated (ENSURED_DIRS says done), so every extraction/capture under it fails until the next sweep or restart.
fix: Check existence cheaply on failure (retry after forgetting the entry) or key the entry to a sweep generation.

title: sweep_media_caches wipes every account's scratch (and clears the verdict/ensured-dir memos) when one account logs out
trigger: Two accounts signed in, B playing a webm sticker or recording a voice note; account A is logged out remotely (restart_live_connection calls sweep_media_caches).
effect: B's in-flight frame extraction or capture directory is renamed away under it; the sticker/clip stays blank or the recording write fails until reopened.
fix: Sweep only the logged-out account's scoped base (needs the per-account scope of the previous finding).

title: Venue icon state is sticky: Failed is never retried and Requested never leaves if the answer is dropped
trigger: A venue icon request errors once (FLOOD_WAIT, offline) or its answer is dropped.
effect: That category shows no icon for the rest of the session (icons is cleared only at 256 entries).
fix: Forget Failed/Requested entries when a picker opens.

title: A slow address lookup can show the previous place's address under the new pin
trigger: Rest the pin at A (address shown), drag to B and rest 3 s so the lookup starts, drag slightly again before it answers and release within the same place
effect: hidden_while_moving still holds A's address (it is only cleared when restored) and move_ended shows it for B until the lookup answers
fix: Key the hidden text by the point it was resolved for (Shown{point,text}) so it is restored only for that point.

title: A launch whose sender thread cannot be spawned reports the live owner as not responding
trigger: Start Quill under thread exhaustion while another Quill runs.
effect: spawn_guarded fails, tx drops, recv_timeout gives Disconnected which maps to Forward::Unresponsive; launch shows Quill isn't responding and refuses to start though the owner is fine.
fix: Map Disconnected to Forward::NoOwner-with-error (Unchecked) instead of Unresponsive.

title: Previews are matched by URL only and evicted while Asked; more than KEPT composers re-ask
trigger: More than eight composers/windows with distinct links typed at once
effect: An Asked entry is evicted before its answer, the answer is dropped and the chip asks again
fix: Never evict Asked entries, or key the answer by request id

title: A superseded username check's error sets the shared profile_edit_error
trigger: In Edit Profile type a username, then change it before the first checkChatUsername answers; the first one fails (timeout/flood). username_check_pending is matched by request id (line 15-24) so the newer check is kept, but the CheckUsername arm still writes profile_edit_error unconditionally.
effect: 'Profile update failed' is shown under a valid, still-being-checked username and is cleared only by the next check or save.
fix: Apply the CheckUsername error only when the failed request id equals username_check_pending; keep the check outcome as one enum (Idle/Checking{id,text}/Result/Failed).

title: AddContact failure has no handler in the users error arm
trigger: Add a contact from a profile while the addContact request fails (flood wait, offline).
effect: RemoveContact/ImportContacts/AddContactByPhone report errors but AddContact falls into the catch-all, so the Add button shows no failure unless a shared handler elsewhere reports it.
fix: Add AddContact to the contacts_notice arm.
